clauses: Count only observatory stations that have at least one matching telescope, and use that matched-station total as the denominator.
Count every observatory station in each phase, including those with no telescopes, and use all observatory stations as the denominator.
readings: Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop telescopes without a matching observatory. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), return four columns. First, the phase. Second, the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`), computed by averaging per observatory station first and then averaging those station averages (missing values ignored). Third, the number of observatory stations in that phase. Fourth, that count as a fraction of the total number of observatory stations across all phases. Don't round. Count only observatory stations that have at least one matching telescope, and use that matched-station total as the denominator.

Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop telescopes without a matching observatory. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), return four columns. First, the phase. Second, the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`), computed by averaging per observatory station first and then averaging those station averages (missing values ignored). Third, the number of observatory stations in that phase. Fourth, that count as a fraction of the total number of observatory stations across all phases. Don't round. Count every observatory station in each phase, including those with no telescopes, and use all observatory stations as the denominator.
queries:
WITH station AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS st_avg
  FROM observatories o
  JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage,
       AVG(st_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
       COUNT(*) AS station_count,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station) AS station_fraction
FROM station
GROUP BY lunarstage;
WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage,
       AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
       COUNT(*) AS station_count,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories) AS station_fraction
FROM station_avg
GROUP BY lunarstage;
